name: RMAN 恢复操作诊断
description: RMAN 恢复涵盖完全恢复、不完全恢复（PITR）、表空间/数据文件恢复、以及表级恢复（12c+）。常见问题包括备份链不完整、归档缺失、恢复中断。

signals.desc: 数据文件需要更多恢复

root_causes.name: 备份链不完整
root_causes.desc: 归档日志缺失导致恢复停止。

root_causes.name: 备份不可用
root_causes.desc: retention 清理了所需备份或介质损坏。

root_causes.name: CDB/PDB 恢复混淆
root_causes.desc: 多租户环境恢复操作错误。

root_causes.name: 恢复时空间不足
root_causes.desc: RESTORE 需等同数据文件的空间。

oltp.desc: RTO < 4 小时，优先 Flashback 或增量合并

olap.desc: RTO 可放宽但数据量大

step1_check_datafile_status.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recover_file_count, MIN(checkpoint_time) AS oldest_checkpoint FROM v$datafile WHERE status IN ('RECOVER', 'OFFLINE')

step2_check_archivelog_gap.desc: 归档日志连续性检查（是否有gap）
step2_check_archivelog_gap.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gap_count FROM (SELECT thread#, sequence#, LEAD(sequence#) OVER (PARTITION BY thread# ORDER BY sequence#) AS next_seq FROM v$archived_log WHERE completion_time > SYSDATE - 7) WHERE next_seq - sequence# > 1

step3_check_backup_availability.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS available_backup_count, MAX(completion_time) AS latest_backup_time FROM v$backup_set WHERE status = 'A'

step4_check_disk_space.sql: SELECT tablespace_name, ROUND((bytes - free_bytes)/1024/1024/1024, 2) AS used_gb, ROUND(free_bytes/1024/1024/1024, 2) AS free_gb FROM (SELECT t.tablespace_name, t.bytes, NVL(f.free_bytes, 0) AS free_bytes FROM (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) bytes FROM dba_data_files GROUP BY tablespace_name) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) free_bytes FROM dba_free_space GROUP BY tablespace_name) f ON t.tablespace_name = f.tablespace_name) ORDER BY free_gb ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

then.step: Step 2: 检查归档日志连续性

branches.label: 归档日志有 gap — 备份链不完整
branches.confidence: 置信度 92%: 归档gap确认备份链断裂

需找到缺失的归档或执行不完全恢复

actions.desc: 尝试从备份中恢复缺失归档
actions.sql: RESTORE ARCHIVELOG FROM SEQUENCE {missing_start} UNTIL SEQUENCE {missing_end};

actions.desc: 如归档不可恢复，执行 PITR 到 gap 前的时间点
actions.risk: 丢失 gap 之后的数据
actions.rollback: Flashback Database 回到恢复前状态

branches.label: 归档连续，检查备份集可用性

branches.label: 无可用备份 — 备份不可用
branches.confidence: 置信度 90%: 无可用备份集
findings: 所有备份集状态非 AVAILABLE，retention 可能已清理或介质损坏

actions.desc: 检查备份介质，尝试 CROSSCHECK 和 CATALOG

branches.label: 有可用备份 — 可以恢复

actions.risk: 恢复期间数据文件不可用
